subject: RFP: EMEA pilot - tri-vendor CS tooling (Intercom / Gainsight / Zendesk)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@intercom.com>, Laura Mendes <laura.m@gainsight.com>, Diego Ruiz <d.ruiz@zendesk.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: EMEA pilot - tri-vendor CS tooling (Intercom / Gainsight / Zendesk)

Hi all,

Thanks for being open to participating — we’re running a focused 6-week RFP to select a partner (or set of partners) for an EMEA pilot. Objective: validate an operational stack to support in-product messaging + tickets + enterprise success workflows for our EMEA customers (data residency + SSO required).

What we need from each vendor by EOD Mon 28 Jun:
- Short (2–3 page) summary of your proposed architecture for this pilot (how you’d handle messaging, ticket escalation, and customer success playbooks).
- Itemized 6-month pilot pricing (pilot usage estimates included in the attached pilot-scope).
- Integrations matrix: native support for product events, Gainsight sync (if applicable), and ticket routing rules.
- Security/compliance notes: data residency options, encryption at rest, SOC 2 attestations.
- Typical onboarding timeline and resources we should expect.

Attach: 20270621-pilot-scope-v1.pdf (scope, sample metrics, pilot customers).

Internal note: Vanessa will lead vendor scoring; Marissa will drive integration feasibility; Karthik will handle procurement/legal questions.

Short call available this Wed/Thu if you prefer to walk the scope. Looking forward to your materials.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Samir Khan <samir@intercom.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Mendes <laura.m@gainsight.com>, Diego Ruiz <d.ruiz@zendesk.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: EMEA pilot - tri-vendor CS tooling (Intercom / Gainsight / Zendesk)

Hi Markus (and team),

Appreciate the invite. Intercom can cover the in-product messaging layer plus ticket handoff; we have an EU data residency option and SSO/SCIM support for automations. I’m attaching a short PDF with an example pilot architecture and sample pricing.

Quick clarifying Qs so we can tailor the response:
1) Do you expect a single canonical user identity store (SCIM) or per-product identities for the pilot?
2) Are you estimating concurrent active conversations or monthly MAUs for pricing? (Pilot-scope gave a range — we’ll model both.)
3) Is the intention to keep Gainsight as the success playbook engine, or are you open to native playbooks within Intercom for the pilot?

We can do a 30-minute call Thu 24 Jun 08:00–11:00 PT / 16:00–19:00 CET.

Attached: intercom-pricing-sample.pdf

Best,
Samir Khan
Enterprise Solutions
Intercom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: EMEA pilot - tri-vendor CS tooling (Intercom / Gainsight / Zendesk)

Markus —

Quick internal sync after Samir’s note: scoring should weight operational cost (35%), integration complexity (25%), security/compliance (20%), and time-to-value (20%). Vanessa — can you prep a scoring template? Marissa — please confirm whether product events will be normalized through our telemetry bus or if we expect vendor-specific SDKs (that will change integration effort significantly).

Also: procurement/legal have flagged we should ask vendors to include a standard Data Processing Addendum and detailed subprocessor list in their submission. I’ll add that to the questionnaire.

Karthik
Sr. Product Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses. Attached are two items: 20270628-rfp-questionnaire.xlsx (updated with DPA/subprocessor ask) and 20270628-scoring-sheet.xlsx (Vanessa’s scoring template).

Next steps:
- Vendors: please return completed questionnaire + pricing by EOD Mon 5 Jul.
- Internal: Vanessa to run initial scoring by Fri 9 Jul; Marissa to confirm integration approach by Tue 6 Jul.
- Schedule: decision review week of Jul 12.

I’ve scheduled a 30-minute vendor Q&A for Fri 2 Jul 15:00 CET — invite sent separately. If any vendor needs a different time, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Attachments referenced above.

Cheers,
Markus
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
